item.title: [remix-run/remix] ui v0.14.0 (ui@0.14.0)
item.description:
### Minor Changes
- BREAKING CHANGE: The `animateExit` mixin now starts animations synchronously in `beforeRemove` instead of deferring them to a microtask. This allows `animateLayout` to measure the updated layout when exiting elements are taken out of normal flow. (#12220)
This is unlikely to be a breaking change for most consumers. Custom mixins used alongside `animateExit` may be affected if they inspect computed styles or call `getAnimations` in `beforeRemove` and rely on the exit animation starting later.
- `animateEntrance` and `animateExit` mixins now support per-property timing and compositing overrides via the `transition` option. (#12220)
- Validate native controls with a shared form schema using `@remix-run/ui/form`. `form.Context` supplies field bindings, and `root`, `control`, `label`, and `error` mixins provide native constraints, validation feedback, and accessible associations. Failed submissions restore values and display errors. Applications own the markup, and

item.title: [nanaism/yomiyasu] v3.2.0
item.description:
yomiyasu v3.2.0 を公開しました。 読点の検査（lint の `pause_comma`）の誤った指摘と見落としを直し、推敲の前後を比べる diff の「意味が変わる恐れ」を見直したバージョンです。 推敲の結果が変わるので、マイナーバージョンにしています。 推敲の手順で直したのは、SKILL.md の読点の段落と、references/slop-catalog.md の読点と言い回しの表だけです。
## nihongo に学んだこと
このバージョンの diff の見直しでは、AnIT さんの nihongo から多くを学びました。 nihongo は、AI が書く日本語を、その場で人が書く文に近づけるエージェントスキルです。推敲の最後に前と後を比べ、数値、否定、確かさ、強さ、程度の言葉が変わった文を見つけて原文に戻すスクリプトを持っています。
nihongo の考え方を手がかりに yomiyasu の diff を調べ直すと、見落としていた変化がいくつも見つかりました。次の考え方は nihongo から学んだものです。
- 時刻の書き方だけが違う書き換え（18:00 と 18時）を、同じ時刻として扱う - 程度を強める語（大幅に、心より など）が消えたら知らせる - 「必須ではない」（してもしなくてもよい）と「不要」（しなくてよい）を、違う強さとして分ける - 「すべて」「一切」のような範囲の語が消えたら知らせる - 「までに」のような期限の語が消えたら知らせる - 段落から文が丸ごと消えたら知らせる
「2秒を超えたら」が「2秒以上なら」になるような境目の言い方の変化にも、nihongo のスクリプトの結果を見て気づきました。 強める語の一覧に足した語は、nihongo が挙げている語を参考に選びました。消えた文を見るときの内容の語の決め方と、その半分以上が消えたら知らせるという目安も、nihongo に倣っています。規則とコードは yomiyasu の diff の作りに合わせて書いたもので、nihongo のコードは含んでいません。 考え方を公開してくださった AnIT さんに感謝します。
## 背景と課題
v3.1.0 のあとに、読点の扱いと、推敲で落ちた言葉について、記事や例をいくつもいただきました。
読点を減らしたいという要望

item.title: [cli/cli] GitHub CLI 2.105.0 (v2.105.0)
item.description:
## What's Changed
## Subscribe to GitHub Event Streams with `gh event` (preview)
The new `gh event` command set lets agents, integrations, and scripts wait for pull request changes instead of polling GitHub:
```shell # Wait for a review event gh event listen --resource --event com.github.pull_request.review.submitted.v1 --timeout 30m
# Wait for a check suite completion event gh event listen --resource --event com.github.pull_request.check_suite.status.changed.v1 --jq .data.conclusion
# List active event subscriptions gh event subscription list ```
By default, `gh event listen` exits after the first event. Use `--count` to wait for several events or `--follow` to keep listening. Events are printed as CloudEvent JSON objects, with `data.api_url` pointing to the resource that changed.
Supported events include submitted reviews, pull request state and head changes, merge conflicts, and completed check suites. The `subscription create`, `list`, `view`, and `delete`

item.title: [pnpm/pnpm] pnpm 12.22.0 (v12.22.0)
item.description:
pnpm 12.22.0 adds a `globalPackagesConfig` section to the global `config.yaml` for settings that apply only to global packages, adds `pnpm why --ranges`, and lists workspace projects in dependency order in `pnpm list --recursive`. It also includes a security fix. After the default or a scoped registry changed, `pnpm install` could skip the `minimumReleaseAge` and `trustPolicy` checks against the new registry.

`pnpm approve-builds -g` and `pnpm add -g --allow-build` now save build decisions under `globalPackagesConfig.permissions`. pnpm still applies build settings from the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` of the global packages directory, with a deprecation warning. The next ap

item.title: [bluesky-social/atproto] @atproto/oauth-provider@0.26.0
item.description:
### Minor Changes
- #5919 `8d84a6c` Thanks @matthieusieben! - Upgrade `ioredis` to 6.x. By default, the Redis clients these packages create stay on RESP2 and skip `CLIENT SETINFO` on connect, as with `ioredis` 5, and take `ioredis` 6's other new defaults:
- `family` is `0` (was `4`): hostnames resolve to IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, not only IPv4. - `retryStrategy` waits 50ms × 2^(attempt − 1), up to 5s, plus up to 200ms of jitter, between reconnection attempts (was 50ms × attempt, up to 2s). - `keepAlive` is `30000`: TCP keepalive probes start after 30s of idle (was off).
The `redis` option of `OAuthProvider` now expects an `ioredis` 6 `Redis` instance, which is used as is, or `RedisOptions`, which can override these defaults.

item.title: [anomalyco/opentui] Release v0.9.0 (v0.9.0)
item.description:
In 0.9.0, Markdown runs on OpenTUI's native engine, the same engine the Rust widget uses. In 0.8.3, `MarkdownRenderable` parsed with `marked` in JavaScript and lexed the open end of the document again on every chunk. In a growing list, the open end is the whole list, so streaming one list took 21,430 million instructions. `MarkdownRenderable` also sent all prose to the Tree-sitter worker for styling. The native engine reads each chunk once and writes paragraphs and headings into their text nodes itself. Streaming the same list now takes 5.9 million instructions. Over one streamed answer, JavaScript's styled-text writes for prose went from 1,595 to 0, and the prose characters sent to the highlighter went from 56,223 to 0.
Because the engine follows CommonMark 0.31.2 and GFM, some documents look different. While streaming, a line that can still change kind, such as a possible table row or a heading underline, waits for its end before it shows. A table appears when its delimiter row arri
